meta.name: high-end-visual-design
meta.description: Teaches the AI to design like a high-end agency. Defines the exact fonts, spacing, shadows, card structures, and animations that make a website feel expensive. Blocks all the common defaults that make AI designs look cheap or generic.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让网页设计拥有高端品牌质感
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让AI生成的设计摆脱廉价感、更像专业工作室出品。
copy.tagline_en: Make web designs feel premium and agency-crafted
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI-generated designs to look expensive and professional.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照高端设计机构的规范生成网页代码，包括特定字体、间距、阴影、卡片结构和动画，避免常见 AI 设计的廉价感。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 设计网页或生成 UI 代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 SaaS 产品的着陆页，要高端感。
生成一个奢侈品品牌的首页，用 Editorial Luxury 风格。
say.note: Claude 会使用暖色调、衬线字体和噪点纹理。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates web code following high-end design agency standards, including specific fonts, spacing, shadows, card structures, and animations, avoiding common cheap AI design defaults.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to design a webpage or generate UI code.

say_en.text: Design a landing page for a SaaS product with a premium feel.
say_en.note: Claude applies Ethereal Glass style and asymmetrical layout.

say_en.text: Generate a homepage for a luxury brand using Editorial Luxury style.
say_en.note: Claude uses warm tones, serif fonts, and noise overlay.
